certain symptoms frequently occur together in a particular group of patients
how frequently the pair occurs across the entire database
how often the consequent occurs in transactions that contain the antecedent
options_en: how often the consequent occurs among transactions containing the antecedent

how frequently the pair occurs across the entire database

questions.question: What does Lift compare?
options: how often the consequent occurs in transactions that contain the antecedent
recommend additional products to customers based on their current selections
their actual co-occurrence with the co-occurrence expected if they were independent
how often the consequent occurs among transactions containing the antecedent
options_en: how often the consequent occurs in transactions that contain the antecedent
recommend additional products to customers based on their current selections
their actual co-occurrence with the co-occurrence expected if they were independent
how often the consequent occurs among transactions containing the antecedent

questions.explanation: Lift measures the strength of the association between the antecedent and consequent by comparing their actual co-occurrence with the co-occurrence expected if they were independent.
questions.explanation_ar: تزامن ظهورهما الفعلي بتزامن الظهور المتوقع لو كانا مستقلين

questions.question: When the Lift measure exceeds 1, how are the items associated?
questions.question_ar: عندما تتجاوز قيمة Lift العدد 1، كيف يكون ارتباط العنصرين؟
questions.explanation: A Lift above 1 means the two items are positively associated.
questions.explanation_ar: ارتباط إيجابي: الرفع أكبر من 1 يعني أن العنصرين يظهران معاً أكثر من المتوقع.

questions.question: What does Lift equal to 1 indicate?
options_ar: وجود ارتباط سلبي بين العنصرين في البيانات
لا يوجد ارتباط أو استقلال بين العنصرين
وجود ارتباط إيجابي بين العنصرين في البيانات
وجود علاقة سببية بين العنصرين في البيانات
questions.explanation: A Lift equal to 1 means no association, so the items are independent.
questions.explanation_ar: عدم وجود ارتباط: الرفع يساوي 1 يعني أن العنصرين مستقلان تماماً.

questions.question: What association does a Lift value below 1 signify?
questions.question_ar: ما نوع الارتباط الذي تدل عليه قيمة Lift الأقل من 1؟
questions.explanation: A Lift below 1 means the two items are negatively associated.
questions.explanation_ar: ارتباط سلبي: الرفع أقل من 1 يعني أن ظهور أحدهما يقلّل ظهور الآخر.

questions.question: What does a very low Support value suggest about a rule?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يشير إليه دعم منخفض جداً للقاعدة؟
options: it must have a very high lift
options_en: it must have a very high lift
questions.explanation: Low support means the itemset appears in only a small share of the transactions.
questions.explanation_ar: الدعم المنخفض يعني أن المجموعة تظهر في نسبة صغيرة من المعاملات.

questions.question: What does a Confidence of one hundred percent mean?
questions.explanation: Full confidence means every transaction containing X also contains Y.
questions.explanation_ar: الثقة الكاملة تعني أن كل معاملة تحوي X تحوي Y أيضاً.

questions.question: What does a Lift of exactly one mean?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يعني رفع يساوي واحداً بالضبط؟
options: the rule is always true here
options_en: the rule is always true here
questions.explanation: Lift of one means the two items occur together exactly as often as independence predicts.
questions.explanation_ar: الرفع يساوي واحداً يعني أن ظهورهما معاً يطابق ما تتوقعه الاستقلالية تماماً.

These measures describe association, not causation.
